description: Hi! I’m so excited for this space mission game. I love aliens, outer space, and imagining new worlds! I am really good at coming up with wild ideas / drawing cool spacesuits / staying super focused and helping everyone on my team. You should join my team because we are going to have the most creative ideas and the best time working together! I am looking for friends who are great at fixing problems / doing math / making cool pictures. Let’s blast off together
summary:
We built a fun space game called Mars Mission Architect! In our game, players become junior space builders who design and build a safe home for astronauts on the Red Planet. Players pick smart spots on Mars, place strong space domes, add solar panels for power, and grow space plants for food and fresh air.
Mars is super cold, dusty, and has no air we can breathe. Our game solves this challenge by teaching kids and families how astronauts can live safely on Mars using real science rules. If a base runs out of power, water, or air, the game shows what went wrong so players can fix their design and try again.
This project is important because young kids like us are the future astronauts and space engineers! Learning how to build on Mars through play helps everyone understand space science, teamwork, and how to take care of our resources both on Mars and here on Earth.
details:
Mars Mission Architect

Detailed Project Description & How It Works

Our Big Idea

We love space and wanted to know how astronauts will live on Mars one day! We created Mars Mission Architect, an interactive game where players build their very own Mars colony from scratch. Players get to make big choices just like real NASA scientists and engineers.

How Our Game Works

· 1. Pick a Landing Spot: Players choose a landing spot on the red, rocky ground of Mars.

· 2. Build Space Modules: Players add living domes for sleeping, greenhouses for growing yummy food, solar panels for electricity, and oxygen tanks for breathing.

· 3. Balance Resources: The game checks if the base has enough power, water, air, and food to keep all the astronauts happy and safe.

· 4. Survive Mars Weather: Players must protect their base from Mars dust storms and freezing cold nights!

How We Built It & AI Tool Disclosure

We used Base44 to build our game! Base44 helped us turn our ideas and drawings into a real playable web app. With help from our teacher/mentor, we told Base44 what buildings, buttons, and Mars rules we wanted in the game. We also used AI writing helpers to organize our project notes and check our spelling so judges can read our work easily. All the game ideas, fun rules, and testing were done by us!
